## Description

Adjust aggressiveness and child-order timing based on live spreads, depth, volume, volatility and deadline urgency.

## Where it may fit

Large orders across changing liquidity conditions where fixed schedules underperform.

## Vehicles

Institutional equities, ETFs, futures and FX execution.

## Required data

Parent order/deadline, real-time quotes/depth, intraday volume forecast, volatility, fills, venue fees and constraints.

## Caveats

Optimization objective must balance cost, completion risk and information leakage; vendor methods vary.
